title: Artemis II: “Taking care of space means taking care of Earth”
summary: The NASA spacecraft carrying four astronauts splashed down as planned Friday off the California coast, capping the US space agency's successful crewed test mission around the Moon — the first such flyby in more than 50 years. Olivier Sanguy, Editor-in-Chief of Space News at the Cité de l'Espace in Toulouse, explains more about the spacecraft’s splashdown an…
